name: Mahou no Kuni no Oujo-sama
source:
This is an adult-oriented visual novel with After Effects animation featuring the princess of Sei*en Densetsu 3 who is brutalized by tentacle monster.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ114598.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
